verdict.rationale: Docs describe running tasks on multiple remote hosts/workers, multi-repo workspaces, and CI/cron-triggered automation sessions ('humanlayer automation run' can be invoked repeatedly across environments), which supports scaling concurrent agent work across a team. However, there is no explicit documentation of a native mechanism for launching or managing 'many' simultaneous tasks/sessions at once, no throughput metrics, and no independent evidence of teams running large-scale concurrent workloads. Missing for 10: explicit multi-session concurrency controls/dashboard, documented scaling limits or throughput benchmarks, and independent hands-on corroboration of running many tasks in parallel.
